notes: Modified cash basis school district (FYE 2025-08-31); basis cash. Governmental funds statement Total Governmental Funds column used for receipts/disbursements (trimmed p3-4); the 1,300,000 General-to-Depreciation transfer is eliminated in the total column (reclassifications), so top-level transfers are null. Beginning/ending cash = beginning/ending fund balance/net position 12,367,024 / 14,409,380 (cash basis, assets less payroll withholdings payable). Balance sheet from the Statement of Activities and Net Position (p2) (no separate statement of net position title); county treasurer balances included in cash and investments. Detail: General Fund recorded from the budget schedule (p8-12), more detailed than the combining schedule (p6-7), which is not recorded to avoid double counting; its Depreciation and Employee Benefit columns come from their own schedules (p13-14). Hidden transfer: General Fund schedule total 19,843,166 includes 1,300,000 later reclassified as transfer to Depreciation Fund (250,000 central services, 250,000 operation and maintenance, 800,000 from state/federal programs net of reclass to regular instruction); recorded as contra lines plus an other financing line (-1,300,000). State and federal program lines categorized as instruction because the report reclassifies them to Regular instruction. General Fund 5000 Debt services split into interest 4,985 and loan repayment 30,961 using the p4 statement. Statement 'Student activities' 446,137 = Activities receipts 445,068 + Student Fee 1,069, categorized charges for services. Employee Benefit budget-only transfer to General Fund (no actual) omitted. Activities fund total receipts 461,682 and Student Fee total disbursements 7,571 include interfund transfers (5,219). Read pages 1-21 of 21 The roll-forward figures 12,367,024 / 14,409,380 are the printed fund balances (p4), also stored in beginning/ending_fund_balance; they are kept in beginning/ending_cash as the cash-basis roll-forward measure. Cash on hand at year end is 14,443,998 (p2), less payroll withholdings payable 34,618.
